encoding.field: 964 x 406 PNG, value = DN x step, DN 255 = no data
encoding.series: uint16 little-endian [3928 days][SM, VOD, OMEGA] per land cell, 65535 = no data, value = raw x series_scale

archives.clim: clim/HDCA_{VAR}_clim.pmtiles  z9/x=0 record mean, 1..12 calendar month/y0
archives.series: series/HDCA_series_r<r0>-<r1>.pmtiles  z10/x=column/y=row (one file per row band)

source.format: NetCDF-4 (zlib), float32; SM, VOD, OMEGA, TBv, TBh, Teff + 2-D latitude/longitude
source.input: SMAP L3 Radiometer Global Daily 36 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture (SPL3SMP v9), AM overpass
